scope: Six changed core/test files and targeted inferred-order recovery checks

core_enumeration.finding: Strict page separation can disambiguate candidates across independent trusted runs. It does not prove sentence equivalence or authorize concatenating those runs. A typed page-order proof path is not currently implemented.

all_sector_scope.finding: Old Executive Summary and new Preface labels are plain Body blocks. Existing numbered-section pairing yields no corresponding section evidence. Matching page number alone does not identify the rewritten sentence.
